breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal axial force as piecewise constant, computing distinct values for each segment (N_AB = -16000 N, N_BC = +2000 N, N_CD = -10000 N) rather than treating it as uniform along the full length. This directly contradicts and corrects the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.reason: The generated specification resolves the problem segment by segment, computing separate stresses (σ_AB = -32 MPa, σ_BC = +4 MPa, σ_CD = -20 MPa) and separate deformations for each segment before summing to get the total displacement.
